title: Restraining Order

signers.label: Approving Judge
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval -- not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: Built from Bar Procedures Section 7C. A TRO is filed with a Law Enforcement Officer and valid for 7 days. A Full Restraining Order requires a court petition and runs from 7 days up to 6 months. This form covers both scenarios -- the 'order_type' field determines which. The approving judge field is filled by whichever authority (LEO for TRO, Judge/Justice for Full Order) approves the request.

fields.label: Type of Order
fields.prompt: What type of restraining order are you filing for?

fields.label: Order Duration
fields.prompt: How long should this order be in effect? (TROs: max 7 days. Full Orders: 7 days to 6 months.)

fields.label: Petitioner
fields.prompt: What is your full legal name (the person requesting protection)?

fields.label: Petitioner CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Petitioner Discordia
fields.prompt: What Discord email/account do you have on file?

fields.label: Respondent Name
fields.prompt: What is the full name of the person you are seeking the restraining order against?

fields.label: Respondent CID
fields.prompt: What is the CID of the person you are seeking the restraining order against? (Enter "Unknown" if you do not have it.)

fields.label: Known Aliases
fields.prompt: Does the respondent have any known aliases or alternative names? (Answer "None" if not applicable.)

fields.label: Protected Locations
fields.prompt: List the locations the respondent should be barred from approaching (e.g. your home, workplace, specific addresses). Provide as much detail as possible.

fields.label: Grounds for Order
fields.prompt: Describe the specific incidents of harassment, abuse, threats, or violence that justify this restraining order. Include dates and any evidence or reports if available.

fields.label: Terms & Conditions
fields.prompt: What specific restrictions should the order place on the respondent? (e.g. no contact, no approach within X feet, no attending specified locations.)

fields.label: LEO Badge (if TRO)
fields.prompt: If this is a TRO: what is the badge number of the Law Enforcement Officer who reviewed and granted this temporary order? If this is a Full Order, answer "N/A".

fields.label: Approving Authority
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. For a TRO this is the LEO's name; for a Full Order this is the Judge/Justice's name.

fields.label: Title / Badge
fields.note: e.g. 'Police Officer, Badge #1234' for a TRO, or 'Justice of the Supreme Court' for a Full Order.
